title: Cabincraft
body:
![Logo of Cabincraft ("Cabincraft")](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/228500331916535003a0dcda034d7904c3e82815_0.webp)

A Modpack with Vanilla+ style visuals with a shifted objective.
In many modpacks, the general goal is to beat the Ender dragon, here, the goal is simply to build yourself a cottage and sustain yourself.
A cozy gaming experience best fit for peaceful or easy mode.
This is my first modpack and i'm still learning how to do things, please be patient with issues.
happy holidays :)
